name: Axplorers
summary: Warm paper-and-sand luxury travel agency site with a golden-hour video hero, a glass enquiry bar and pill-shaped photo inlays inside the headline type.

fonts.pairing: soft bookish serif at 500 for headings and buttons, rounded geometric sans for body, labels and uppercase eyebrows

signature: pill-shaped photo capsules set inline between words of a centred display statement
frosted glass enquiry form docked along the bottom of the video hero
dark full-bleed photo cards with price chip top right, rating and duration pills and a full-width sand button
headline accent word tinted gold, often italic, at the end of every H2
imagery: golden-hour AI travel photography: cliffside terraces, temples, aurora, candlelit dinners; warm amber grade throughout
layout_grid: 1200px canvas, 40px side padding, 80px section padding, 3-column card grids with 20px gaps, 20px card radius
